- Learning analytics, reports, and certification tracking

## Frequently asked questions

How does Disprz pricing work for enterprises?


Disprz follows an enterprise subscription model based on your organization’s scale and requirements. Pricing is structured around platform capabilities, usage scope, and deployment complexity rather than flat packages.

Is the Disprz subscription linked to the number of learners?


Yes. Pricing typically scales with the number of active learners, along with selected capabilities. This ensures predictable costs as adoption grows across teams.

Does Disprz offer customized plans for large organizations?


Yes. Enterprise plans are tailored based on your learning strategy, regions, integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills and learner experience.

What factors influence the overall cost of Disprz?


Key factors include number of learners, selected modules, AI usage, integrations, and regional deployment needs. Complexity and scale directly shape the final subscription.

Are AI powered learning capabilities included in Disprz plans?


Yes. AI powered learning experiences are included in the Enterprise plan. Advanced agentic AI capabilities are available as usage based add ons, allowing organizations to scale AI adoption as needed.

Can the plan scale as our workforce and learning needs grow?


Absolutely. Disprz is built to scale seamlessly as your workforce expands, new regions are added, or learning requirements evolve over time.

Is Disprz suitable for multi-region or global deployments?


Yes. Disprz supports multi region deployments with localization, role based access, integrations, and governance designed for global organizations.

What integrations does Disprz support?


Disprz supports a wide range of integrations to connect with your HR ecosystem and business tools. This includes single sign-on (SSO), HRIS/HCM systems, content libraries, collaboration tools, calendars, and analytics platforms. Additional API-based integrations make it easy to extend Disprz across your technology stack.
